title: Towards Robust, Performance-Based Contamination Detection for LLMs
description: Our evasion is an argmax-preserving logit transform that makes signals on contaminated items resemble those on unseen items, while leaving every benchmark answer unchanged. We then introduce a detector based on Item Response Theory (IRT) residuals, which calibrates item difficulty on a population of 102 LLMs and flags items where a model outperforms its estimated ability. Because it reads only binary responses, its AUROC is exactly unchanged under the evasion.

inputs.label: Contamination strength
inputs.description: Fraction of the member items the model used to get wrong that contamination makes it answer right (paper: member accuracy 0.60 → 0.99 ≈ 0.97). Try 0.3 for light contamination

inputs.label: Memorization boost
inputs.description: How much training sharpens next-token probabilities on member text (drives the confidence detectors)

inputs.label: Calibration items
inputs.description: Items used only to estimate θ̂
